disclaimer: Guidance only. Stop and call a professional if unsure or if there's any danger.

stop.title: Stop — call a professional
stop.generic: This looks unsafe to fix yourself. Stop and call a qualified professional.
stop.gas: This may involve gas. Do not attempt a repair. Turn off the supply only if it is safe, leave the area, and call a qualified professional.
stop.electricity: This may involve mains electricity. Do not touch exposed parts. Call a qualified electrician.
stop.fuel: This may involve fuel. Keep flames and sparks away and call a qualified professional.
stop.structural: This may affect the structure of the building. Do not disturb it. Call a qualified professional.
stop.brakes: This involves vehicle brakes. Do not ride or drive. Take the vehicle to a qualified mechanic.
stop.medical: FixCV cannot help with injuries or health issues. Please contact a medical professional.
stop.model: The assistant flagged this as unsafe. Stop and call a qualified professional.

ui.tapPrompt: Point the camera at the broken object, then tap the faulty part.
ui.describePlaceholder: e.g. The bike chain keeps slipping off
ui.callPro: Call a professional if anything is still wrong or feels unsafe.
